newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Socialists want fresh look at Thomson-CSF.
newsitem.headline: French Socialists want fresh look at Thomson-CSF.

text.p: France's opposition Socialist Party will take a fresh look at state plans to privatise defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF, party official Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Friday.

Plans to sell off Thomson-CSF and also Thomson Multimedia (TMM) "were prepared a little too hastily by the current majority and with an ideological rather than an industrial or professional slant," Strauss-Kahn, co-author of the party's economic plan, told Reuters in an interview. The government has agreed to consider rival bids for Thomson-CSF from Alcatel Alsthom and Lagardere Groupe.
"We must take a fresh look at the procedure and the matter of Thomson-CSF's future before we can determine the most opportune legal form," he said.

Strauss-Kahn added the Socialists would also take a new look at the planned privatisation of Thomson Multimedia, the consumer electronics arm of Thomson SA, as well as a planned merger of Dassault Aviation and Aerospatiale .
On Wednesday, Socialist spokesman Francois Hollande told Reuters the party hoped to assemble a state-owned defence arm grouping Thomson-CSF, Dassault and Aerospatiale.
